title: External Credentials — Issue — payload
description: Obtain a short-lived, downscoped provider credential from an external account, sealed to the caller: session or token credentials under `scope`, or a batch of presigned requests on one object under `presign`. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

scope.description: For every brokered model but `s3-static-presign`: the prefix and actions, or the OAuth scopes, the session or token is downscoped to. `objectKey` is not used in this version.

ttlSeconds.description: Requested lifetime; never more than the binding's `maxTtlSeconds`. For `presign`, the lifetime of every URL in the batch.

ChecksumSha256.title: ChecksumSha256
ChecksumSha256.description: A SHA-256 digest in standard base64 (RFC 4648 §4, padded), as S3 carries it in `x-amz-checksum-sha256`.

PresignBatch.title: PresignBatch
PresignBatch.description: `s3-static-presign` only: up to 128 operations on **one** object, `prefix` + `objectKey`, and at most one multipart upload of it. Each operation becomes one presigned request, sealed together. Consistency rules JSON Schema cannot state, which the custodian enforces: `uploadId` is present exactly when an operation needs it (`upload-part`, `list-parts`, `complete-multipart`, `abort-multipart`) and absent when the batch holds `create-multipart`; no two operations are identical; no two `upload-part` operations name the same `partNumber`.

objectKey.description: The object's name within `prefix`. Every request in the batch names `prefix` + `objectKey` and no other object.

uploadId.description: The multipart upload the batch's multipart operations act on, as storage returned it from CreateMultipartUpload. Signed into each such request's query, percent-encoded by the SigV4 encoder, never interpolated.

PresignRequest.title: PresignRequest
PresignRequest.description: One operation to presign, discriminated by `operation`. The ceiling action each needs is in `PresignOperation`.

oneOf.title: PresignPut
oneOf.description: PutObject of the whole object, bound to its exact length and SHA-256.

contentLength.description: The object's exact length in bytes, signed into the request as `Content-Length`. At most 5 GiB, S3's single-request ceiling.

oneOf.title: PresignHead
oneOf.description: HeadObject, with `x-amz-checksum-mode: ENABLED` signed so storage reports the object's checksum.

oneOf.title: PresignCreateMultipart
oneOf.description: CreateMultipartUpload, with `x-amz-checksum-algorithm: SHA256` signed so every part of the upload must carry a SHA-256 checksum.

oneOf.title: PresignUploadPart
oneOf.description: UploadPart of one part of `uploadId`, bound to its number, its exact length and its SHA-256.

contentLength.description: The part's exact length in bytes, signed into the request as `Content-Length`. At most 5 GiB, S3's part ceiling.

oneOf.title: PresignListParts
oneOf.description: ListParts of `uploadId`: each part's number, length, ETag and checksum, up to 1000 per page.

partNumberMarker.description: List parts after this number. Absent, from the first.

oneOf.title: PresignCompleteMultipart
oneOf.description: CompleteMultipartUpload of `uploadId`, bound to the assembled object's exact length.

contentLength.description: The assembled object's exact length in bytes, signed into the request as `x-amz-mp-object-size`, so storage refuses a completion that would assemble any other size. At most 5 TiB, S3's object ceiling.

sealedCredential.pattern: ^-----BEGIN VTA SEALED BUNDLE-----[\s\S]+-----END VTA SEALED BUNDLE-----\s*$
sealedCredential.description: A `SealedTransferBundle` (external/_shared/0.1), sealed to the caller's key-agreement key, whose cleartext is an `ExternalCredentialPayload` for `scope` or a `PresignedRequestSet` for `presign`. Bounded at 256 KiB rather than the shared 64 KiB because a batch of 128 presigned requests does not fit 64 KiB.

expiresAt.description: The provider's expiry for the credential, in the clear; for `presign`, the earliest expiry in the batch.

scope.description: The scope actually granted, which equals the requested one.

presign.description: The batch actually presigned, which equals the requested one.
